cards.title: What digital marketing is — meeting customers on their phones
cards.takeaway: Digital marketing means promoting products or services through digital channels (phones, search engines, social media, WhatsApp, email) where customers already spend their day.
cards.body: Think of a Port Harcourt baker or tailor: flyers on electric poles get rained on, whereas **digital marketing** puts your work straight onto the phone screen of someone searching *'birthday cake near Rumuola'* right now!

cards.title: The 8 main digital marketing channels (vs. offline TV/radio)
cards.takeaway: Digital channels run on devices/internet (Search/SEO, Google Business Profile, Social Media, Paid Ads, Content, Email, WhatsApp/Messaging, Video) — traditional Television is offline!
cards.body:
Know the **8 digital channels** that work together online:
1. **Search (SEO)** — showing up on Google searches
2. **Google Business Profile (Local Maps)** — showing address, hours & reviews
3. **Social Media** (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
4. **Paid Digital Ads** (Meta Ads, Google Ads)
5. **Content Marketing** (helpful articles/guides)
6. **Video Marketing** (YouTube, Reels, TikTok)
7. **Email Marketing**
8. **WhatsApp & Direct Messaging**

*(Note: Traditional **Television**, radio, and roadside billboards are **offline/traditional** channels, not one of the eight digital channels!)*

check.prompt: Which of the following is a traditional OFFLINE channel rather than one of the eight digital marketing channels?
check.hint: Seven billion phones use Google, social, and email online — broadcast TV is traditional offline media!
check.explanation: Correct! Broadcast television is a traditional offline channel, unlike SEO, Google Business Profile, social media, and email.

cards.title: The 4-Stage Marketing Funnel: Awareness → Consideration → Conversion → Retention
cards.takeaway: Strangers rarely buy in 1 second! They move from Awareness (discover you) → Consideration (compare & trust) → Conversion (pay/order) → Retention (buy again & refer).
cards.body:
Every real customer travels through **four stages**:
1. **Awareness:** *'Oh, I didn't know this tailor existed!'* (sees a Reel or Google Map pin).
2. **Consideration:** *'Are they legit and good?'* (checks reviews, prices, past work).
3. **Conversion:** *'Take my money!'* (sends WhatsApp order and pays).
4. **Retention:** *'They delivered on time — I'm ordering again and telling my sister!'*

check.prompt: A shopper already found two cake pages on Instagram and is now reading customer reviews and comparing price lists before choosing. Which funnel stage are they in?
check.hint: They already know you exist (past Awareness) and haven't paid yet (before Conversion) — they are weighing their options!
check.explanation: Spot on! Reading reviews and comparing options happens in the Consideration stage.

cards.title: Why channels work as a chain — and why fake Google reviews backfire!
cards.takeaway: Connect Social + Google Business Profile + WhatsApp so customers don't drop off when searching your name — and earn real reviews honestly instead of writing fake 5-star ones!
cards.body:
Two real-world lessons:
- **Broken chain = lost sale:** If someone sees a tailor's Facebook post, searches his name on Google to check his shop address, and finds **zero Google Business Profile**, they often buy from a competitor who showed up on Google Maps!
- **Never post fake reviews:** Google detects and penalises fake 5-star reviews (and can suspend the business profile!). Instead, ask happy real customers for an honest review right after delivery using a direct review link.

check.prompt: Your friend asks you to post a fake 5-star Google review for her salon even though you have never visited. What is the best advice?

choices.text: Write ten fake reviews from ten accounts today
Decline — fake reviews mislead buyers and risk Google suspending her profile; help her send a one-tap review link to real happy clients instead

check.hint: Google's spam filters flag fake reviews and penalise listings — real customer reviews build lasting ranking and trust.
check.explanation: Exactly right! Asking genuine satisfied clients right after great service builds unstoppable, penalty-free local rankings.
